bundle.shortDescription: Keyboard-fast culling for Canon CR3 RAW photos.
bundle.longDescription: CULL is a desktop app for picking keepers from a folder of Canon CR3 RAW photos. Verdicts save into Lightroom-compatible XMP sidecars so picks and rejects round-trip into Lightroom Classic. Single image (loupe), side-by-side (compare), and contact-sheet (grid) views share one keyboard vocabulary.
